steps.narrate: DemoForge is an LLM-driven web product demo automation framework. It turns web applications into polished demo videos, GIFs, and interactive demo sites — automatically.
The framework is built on five core packages: core, browser, cli, renderer, and site.
Key features include deterministic script replay, video encoding with ffmpeg, synthetic cursor overlay, and visual effects.
Write a declarative demo script in JSON or YAML, and DemoForge handles the rest.
Getting started is simple: initialize a project, write a demo script, and run the render command.
The documentation covers installation, CLI reference, configuration, and API documentation.
DemoForge also supports LLM-powered exploration, where the agent discovers demo flows by analyzing the accessibility tree.
The explorer agent uses JSON schema constraints for action-space enforcement, ensuring valid demo scripts.
Output assets include MP4 video, WebM, GIF, and Animated WebP — all with configurable quality presets and size budgets.
The site generator creates a static demo gallery with search, tag filtering, and light/dark theme support.
Each demo page includes an embedded video player, step timeline with captions, and copyable narration text.
DemoForge is designed for OSS contributors with a monorepo structure, comprehensive testing, and clear contribution guidelines.
